name: Ahmanson Lab
school: Sidney Harman Academy for Polymathic Study
blurb: A lab on the third floor of Leavey Library for experimentation and making, with workshops on design, digital authoring and physical computing. Its equipment page also lists desktop computers and laptops, virtual reality headsets, a drone, a depth camera, a 360 camera and an EEG headset. The page does not say how to borrow or book equipment, so ask the lab.
hours_note: The Leavey Library page lists 9 AM to 9 PM and does not say which days. The lab's own site says staff hold regular lab hours for drop-ins, but lists no times.
access_steps: Email the lab at lvy@usc.edu to ask what you can use and when.
Staff hold regular lab hours so you can drop by and learn about 3D printing, microcontrollers and more. The times are not listed, so ask before you go.
The lab's own site sends questions to Curtis Fletcher at cfletche@usc.edu.
